card.freeBody: You are on a free package, so there is no monthly payment and it never expires. Upgrade any time for more features.
card.notStartedTitle: Your first month is about to start
card.notStartedBody: Your {{plan}} package ({{price}}) starts its first month as soon as your account is active.
card.activeBody: Your {{plan}} package ({{price}}) is paid up. {{days}} days left in this period.
card.expiringBody: Your {{plan}} package ({{price}}) expires on {{date}}. Pay before then to keep your dashboard open.
card.suspendedBody: Your {{plan}} package ({{price}}) has expired and the dashboard is locked. It opens again as soon as the payment is recorded — nothing has been deleted.

banner.title: Your {{plan}} package expires in
banner.body: Pay before {{date}} to avoid your dashboard being locked.

locked.title: Your package has expired
locked.subtitle: The {{plan}} package ran out on {{date}} without a payment, so the dashboard is paused.
locked.step1: Make the payment using the details above.
locked.step2: The Suwela team records it — usually the same working day.
locked.step3: Your dashboard opens again automatically for another month, and you get a notification.
locked.dataSafe: Your records, patients and settings are kept safe while the package is paused. Notifications and your package page still work.

my.subtitle: Your package, its monthly payments, and upgrades or downgrades.
my.oneAtATime: You already have a package change waiting. Cancel it to choose a different one.
my.howChangesWork: An administrator approves every change. If your current period is paid, the new package starts when it ends — you never lose days you have paid for. From a free package, the new one starts straight after approval.
my.whenNextPeriod: Once approved, the new package starts on {{date}}, when your current paid period ends. Your next payment is at the new price.
my.whenApproved: Once approved, the new package starts straight away.
my.messagePlaceholder: e.g. We are adding two more doctors next month
my.pendingTitle: Your {{direction}} to {{plan}} is waiting for approval
my.pendingBody: Requested on {{date}}. You will get a notification when it is decided.
my.approvedBody: The change starts when your current paid period ends.

dashboard.title: Subscriptions & payments
dashboard.allClear: All paid up — {{count}} paid accounts active, nothing due in the next 7 days.

admin.title: Billing & Payments
admin.subtitle: Paid packages run month to month. Mark payments received, watch accounts that are about to expire, and decide upgrade/downgrade requests. Free packages and patients are never billed.
admin.dueNext30_one: Due in the next 30 days ({{count}} account)
admin.dueNext30_other: Due in the next 30 days ({{count}} accounts)
admin.dueHint: These accounts expired without a payment and their dashboards are locked. Recording a payment unlocks them immediately.
admin.expiringHint: Each account was sent reminders 7, 3 and 1 day(s) before. A payment recorded now adds a month to the current end date.
admin.expiringEmpty: No paid package expires in the next 7 days.
admin.requestsHint: Approved changes start with the account's next billing period unless you choose to switch now.
admin.allHint: Every account on a package, soonest expiry first.

decide.nextPeriodHint: Recommended. The month already paid for runs out on its own package; the next payment is at the new price.
decide.nowHint: Switch immediately. The paid-until date stays the same.
decide.immediate: This account has no paid period running (free or lapsed), so the change takes effect straight away.
